unknowns: Stratagem costs/target-team/status flags and rolling-log morale−50 are confirmed; exact durations and fire 20×6s remain unverified.
Ladder types 50/51 are absent from the 34 maps; FUN_0042EA50 only treats them as placement blockers. No climb/siege behavior was found.
Flagship 52 is absent from the 34 maps; FUN_00428A50 rejects it as a duel target. No other original behavior was found.
Duel acceptance is code-confirmed as (兵力A−体力B)×兵力A²×0.006; the remake implementation differs and is tracked as U-02, not as an original ambiguity.

Civilians 27/28 use runtime class 11; they can repair (FUN_00424F70 worker-like; FUN_0045DD90 has no class10 check) but cannot build (FUN_00424F40 is class10-only). Their exact AI/selection priorities remain unverified.

Production rows: FUN_0046C710 derives DAT_004b8d29 from building/HQ state; FUN_00426E40 maps 0/1/2/>2 to 1/3/7/0xF rows. The earlier 'scenario init[0]' reading was withdrawn after tracing FUN_0046C710.
